item.title: Taylor Farms Recalls Salsa, Guacamole on Salmonella Outbreak, Intensifying Food-Safety Fears
item.description: Taylor Farms is recalling prepared foods containing jalapenos from retailers including Walmart and Whole Foods in several states over potential salmonella contamination, the second major foodborne illness linked to the produce supplier in recent weeks. Taylor Farms on Sunday said it stopped sourcing from a Sinaloa, Mexico farm identified as the potential source of salmonella. The recall adds another layer of worry for consumers, who have been avoiding fresh greens at groceries and restaurants after Taylor recalled iceberg lettuce due to a cyclospora outbreak that is already among the largest foodborne illness events in recent U.S.

item.title: Judge Approves $106M Settlement Over Deadly 2019 New Orleans Hard Rock Hotel Collapse
item.description: A judge approved a $106 million settlement Thursday that ends a yearslong legal battle over the deadly 2019 collapse of a Hard Rock Hotel that was under construction in New Orleans. The combined $106 million settlement was approved by Orleans Parish Civil District Court Judge Kern Reese on Thursday, according to Glago and Court records. The 18-story hotel project partially collapsed in October 2019, killing three people and damaging nearby property.

item.title: What to Know About the Salmonella Outbreak in the U.S.
item.description: Here is what we know about the salmonella outbreak so far: Salmonella is a group of rod-shaped bacteria that can cause salmonellosis, a common foodborne illness. health authorities are currently investigating a multi-state outbreak of Salmonella Javiana infections linked to fresh jalapeño peppers. health officials also investigate a multi-state Cyclosporiasis outbreak linked to lettuce supplied by privately held Taylor Farms, a major food-service producer whose customers include Yum Brands’ Taco Bell.

item.title: Anti-Social Driving Crackdown in London Leads to $10M in Seized Sports Cars
item.description: More than £8million (over $10 Million USD) worth of vehicles, including a Ferrari Monza worth £3.7million, were seized in a crackdown on antisocial driving in central London, according an announcement by the city’s Metropolitan Police. Officers from the Met, supported by Motor Insurers’ Bureau, seized a total of 90 vehicles between Friday, 7 August and Sunday, 9 August in an operation targeting uninsured drivers, anti-social and dangerous driving across Hyde Park, Kensington and Chelsea. The seized vehicles include a Ferrari Monza SP2, which had only been in the UK for a day, for driving without insurance and not in accordance with a license.

item.title: Ayman M. Al-Sayari appointed FSB’s Regional Engagement Chair
item.description: Al-Sayari, Governor of the Saudi Central Bank, has been appointed FSB’s Regional Engagement Chair for a two-year term, starting on 10 August 2026. In his role as Regional Engagement Chair, Ayman M. Al-Sayari will advise the FSB Chair and Plenary on how to best leverage the FSB Regional Consultative Groups (RCGs) in supporting the FSB mandate.

item.title: Sidecar evolution driven by asset-side mechanics and valuation discipline: Kroll
item.description: According to executives at financial and risk advisory firm Kroll, navigating this momentum requires strict asset-liability matching, robust valuation methodologies, and a deep understanding of complex collateral mechanics. As reinsurance sidecars increasingly expand into longer-tailed lines of business, the risk profile of these structures is shifting from traditional underwriting toward asset-side management. Artemis recently spoke to Aaron Read, Managing Director, and Michael Sternbach, Vice President, of Kroll, who discussed what sponsors need to be aware of when entering into sidecar deals, as well as what trends their seeing across the space as sidecars gain more popularity amongst investors.

item.title: White Mountains gets $222m capital return from Ark’s Outrigger Re sidecar
item.description: While White Mountains elected not to invest capital into the Outrigger Re collateralized reinsurance sidecar, which supports its P&C insurance and reinsurance subsidiary Ark, for the 2026 underwriting year, the vehicle continues to serve as a major driver of cash flow, returning substantial capital to the firm throughout 2026 so far. While White Mountains did not invest in the sidecar for the 2026 underwriting year, the firm’s latest quarterly results suggest that Outrigger Re still delivered a lot of capital distributions back to it. In the first six months of 2026, White Mountains received $145 million of distributions from WM Outrigger Re, primarily a return of capital related to its non-renewal for the 2026 underwriting year, followed by another $77 million on July 23rd, 2026.

item.title: Kestrel Group sees $6.7m total revenues in Q2’26
item.description: Kestrel Group, a specialty insurance and reinsurance platform, has announced its financial results for the second quarter of 2026, reporting $6.7 million in total revenues despite seeing a net loss of $8.1 million. For the first half of 2026, Kestrel reported total revenues of $16.9 million, compared to $6.4 million reported for the first half of 2025. In Q2 2026, total fee revenues from the Program Services segment were $3.7 million, a 587.9% increase over Q2 2025, a combination of expanding existing and new client accounts.

item.title: Canopius appoints Greg Kuchinski as US CUO
item.description: Canopius Group, a global specialty and P&C re/insurer, has announced the appointment of Greg Kuchinski as US Chief Underwriting Officer (CUO), effective 9 September 2026. Based in New York, Kuchinski will report to Sam Harrison, CUO at Canopius Group, and incoming Canopius US CEO Nadine Moore. His expertise in portfolio management, underwriting discipline and market-leading execution will be invaluable as we continue to focus on winning in areas where we can differentiate ourselves and create a sustainable competitive advantage in the market.” Lindsay Astor, Chief of Staff and Head of Strategy at Canopius Group, added, “We are delighted to welcome Greg to Canopius.

item.title: Munich Re CEO says P&C demand will continue to rise as market moves towards balance
item.description: Christoph Jurecka, Chief Executive Officer (CEO) of Munich Re, one of the world’s largest global reinsurance companies, has said he expects demand for property and casualty (P&C) reinsurance to continue growing over the medium to long term, supported by rising levels of uninsured risk, emerging exposures, and the increasing impact of climate change. Last week, the CEO responded to questions about whether recent changes in market conditions had altered the company’s view of the P&C reinsurance sector and what factors could eventually drive a rebalancing between supply and demand. Addressing the outlook for demand, Jurecka said that his opening comments on market development, in its Q2’26 results call, were focused on the longer-term picture rather than short-term fluctuations.

item.title: Florida-Based Heritage Continues to Shed Policies as Earnings Soar to New Heights
item.description: While a number of Florida-domiciled property insurers have begun rebuilding their policy portfolios in the last 12 months, Tampa-based Heritage Insurance has continued to shed policies in recent years. That’s 5% fewer than seen in the second quarter last year, and almost a quarter-million fewer policies than Heritage held in 2021, at the worst of the Florida property insurance litigation crisis. The publicly traded insurer, ranked 21 st -largest in Florida, reported 350,887 policies in force in Q2 2026, for all of the 17 states it writes in.

item.title: Illinois Lawsuit Alleges Companies Violated Environmental Laws at Chicago Site
item.description: Raoul’s lawsuit, filed in the Cook County Circuit Court, alleges how the companies allowed fires at the site and created an explosion risk at the facility that threatened the health and welfare of nearby residents. The lawsuit also alleges that composting operations at the site violated permitted conditions and that unlawful open dumping and illegal air pollution occurred at the site. “The defendants needed to have addressed the fires sooner and must prevent the conditions that caused them, plus ensure that the site operations comply with Illinois’ environmental laws moving forward.

item.title: FurtherAI appoints former Verkada executive Zachary Hirsch as sales chief
item.description: Insurance AI company FurtherAI has appointed Zachary “Zac” Hirsch as senior vice president of sales as it looks to expand its commercial operations and customer base across the insurance industry. Hirsch will lead FurtherAI’s sales organisation and go-to-market strategy, with a focus on carriers, managing general agents, brokers and wholesalers. He joins from enterprise software company Verkada, where he helped scale the commercial organisation as the business grew to more than  $1 billion .

item.title: GEICO reports $994 million underwriting profit in first half of 2026
item.description: GEICO reported an underwriting profit of $994 million for the first half of 2026, down approximately 45% from the same period a year earlier, as higher claims and underwriting expenses put pressure on results. Premiums earned increased  3% , or $661 million, during the first half of the year. Premiums written increased 1.3% to $289 million more than the prior-year period during the first six months, supported by growth in commercial auto.

item.title: Exzeo launches AI venture division focused on new insurance businesses
item.description: Exzeo has launched Exzeo Ventures, a new division focused on developing AI-native products, services and businesses, with an initial focus on insurance. “AI is fundamentally changing what’s possible, and we believe the companies that create the greatest long-term value build entirely new businesses and not just more efficient versions of existing ones.” Exzeo went public in 2025 and provides technology and services to property/casualty insurers through its Insurance-as-a-Service platform, with a particular focus on homeowners insurance. The division’s initial areas of focus include  agentic AI for catastrophe claims, next-generation underwriting and risk transfer, distribution automation and other AI-enabled insurance products .

item.title: AI Risk Is Rising Fast
item.description: AI acts as a powerful risk accelerator, with the number of incidents and related litigation rising globally. AI has surged to the second-biggest perceived business risk globally, yet actual insurance losses remain surprisingly low—for now. This is clearly reflected in the Allianz Risk Barometer , where AI rose from 10th place worldwide in 2025 to 2nd place in 2026 – the largest increase of any risk category.

item.title: Westland Insurance acquires Interior Savings Insurance
item.description: Westland Insurance has acquired Interior Savings Insurance Services, part of Beem Credit Union, expanding its presence in British Columbia. “We’re excited to welcome Interior Savings Insurance to the Westland family. Interior Savings Insurance operates 13 locations across the Thompson, Okanagan and Similkameen regions and has been serving clients for more than 80 years.

item.title: Marsh McLennan Agency to acquire The Accel Group
item.description: Marsh McLennan Agency has agreed to acquire Accel Holdings, the parent company of Iowa-based independent insurance and advisory firm The Accel Group. Founded in 1936, The Accel Group offers commercial and personal insurance, employee benefits, agribusiness coverage, wealth management and retirement advisory services. It operates seven offices across Iowa, Illinois, Missouri and Kansas and employs more than 130 people, all of whom are expected to join MMA.

item.title: FOXO subsidiary to acquire four blood collection centers
item.description: FOXO Technologies subsidiary Vector BioSource has agreed to acquire certain assets associated with four US blood collection centers from Grifols Bio Supplies. FOXO Technologies expects the acquired operations to generate more than $10 million in net revenue during the first 12 months from sales of whole blood, red blood cells, serum and other biosamples. The acquisition will give Vector its own blood collection capabilities, shifting the company from relying solely on external sourcing toward a more integrated model.

item.description: A total 195 companies joined The Crunchbase Unicorn Board in the first half of 2026 — far surpassing counts seen since the second half of 2022. Already, H1 is above the new unicorn totals for all of 2025, when 193 companies were minted with that status. The most valuable new unicorn this year is China-based open-source model developer DeepSeek , which was valued at $50 billion in its first external financing.

item.title: Reinsurance inflection – Key question is whether irrational competition emerges: AM Best
item.description: With reinsurance capital across the market now at record levels , the rating agency says the key question is, “whether reinsurers can maintain underwriting discipline or will irrational competition emerge leading to another traditional soft market cycle.” Unlike previous hard market cycles, capital accumulated to incumbents rather than a wave of start-ups, as supportive market conditions continue to drive favourable earnings generation for reinsurers. “Consequently, maintaining pricing discipline in casualty business may ultimately prove as important as preserving discipline within the property catastrophe market.” AM Best highlighted the growing investor interest in casualty-linked structures in the insurance-linked securities marketplace, but noted that, “the attractiveness of property catastrophe ILS has proven difficult to replicate within casualty business.” Favourable earnings profile could persist for reinsurance players barring an outsized catastrophe event, but the most important question is whether reinsurers can maintain their pricing discipline, the rating agency said. The global reinsurance market is at an inflection point after consecutive strong year’s of underwriting returns have driven robust capital generation, while inflows continue to grow the insurance-linked securities market and alternative forms of capacity, which leads AM Best to call this an inflection point and ask if pricing discipline will last.

item.title: Strong July boosts UCITS catastrophe bond fund returns, but 12-month drops below 10%
item.description: Catastrophe bond fund strategies in the UCITS format saw performance accelerate through recent weeks as seasonality boosted returns, but the 12-month rolling return average across the Plenum CAT Bond UCITS Fund Indices has now declined to just under 10% for the first time this year. The average return of UCITS catastrophe bond funds for the period from the nearest last end of month reporting of this Index, on June 26th through to July 31st 2026, reached 1.15%. As a result, the average year-to-date performance of the UCITS catastrophe bond fund strategies rose from 2.91% at June 26th 2026, to now 4.09% as of July 31st.

item.title: Hiscox Capital Partners hires Spanos as Senior ILS Actuary
item.description: Hiscox Capital Partners, the division of Hiscox Re that encompasses insurance-linked securities (ILS) investments and quota-share partnerships, has appointed Charalambos (Harry) Spanos as a Senior ILS Actuary. Based in London, Spanos, a seasoned and qualified actuary, has joined Hiscox Capital Partners, bringing with him a decade of experience in ILS and reinsurance. Earlier this year, Hiscox Re, the reinsurance division of Hiscox Group launched Hiscox Capital Partners as a new business unit to consolidate all the capital partnership activity the organisation has managed for nearly two decades, including third-party capital and insurance-linked securities (ILS).

item.title: Acies MGU expands into marine insurance with launch of TEDmar International
item.description: Acies MGU (Acies), a technology and data-driven managing general underwriter (MGU) specialising in the creation and management of niche insurance businesses, has announced its expansion into the marine insurance sector through the launch of TEDmar International (TEDmar), a managing general agent dedicated to the ports and terminals market. They are leading experts in marine insurance, and we’re looking forward to supporting TEDmar’s growth as Acies expands its diverse portfolio of specialist MGAs.” The company stated that TEDmar’s international proposition is fully backed by a consortium providing Lloyd’s capacity and is designed to meet the insurance needs of port authorities and ports and terminals operators.

item.title: FurtherAI hires Zachary Hirsch as SVP of Sales
item.description: FurtherAI, an insurance AI platform, has announced the appointment of Zachary Hirsch as Senior Vice President of Sales. Hirsch joins FurtherAI after more than six years at Verkada, where he most recently served as VP of Sales, NYC + PHL + HQ Select. In his new role, Hirsch will lead the company’s commercial organisation and go-to-market strategy as FurtherAI expands its customer base across carriers, managing general agents, brokers, and wholesalers.

item.title: Swiss Re appoints Damien Bartlett and Karen Tan to L&H leadership roles
item.description: Global reinsurer Swiss Re has announced the appointments of Damien Bartlett as Head of Market Unit Life & Health UK and Ireland and Middle East and Africa, and Karen Tan as Chief Underwriting Officer for L&H Re. Bartlett joins Swiss Re following 25 years at SCOR, where he held a number of senior leadership roles. She has held several leadership roles at Swiss Re, including Head of Life & Health Products Asia and Chief Risk Officer for Asia Pacific.

item.title: Wildfire Forces Evacuations Across Top Canadian Wine Region
item.description: More than 20,000 people were ordered to evacuate one of Canada’s top wine-producing regions as an uncontrolled wildfire spread rapidly, forcing local authorities to declare a province-wide state of emergency. Authorities ordered the town of Summerland and nearby communities in British Columbia’s Okanagan Valley to be evacuated on Saturday as the Bald Range wildfire advanced. Prime Minister Mark Carney posted on social media Saturday that the federal government “stands ready to help and support the government of British Columbia in these efforts.” Last month, a blaze in the eastern Canadian province of Ontario produced smoke that darkened skies and worsened air quality as far south as Washington, DC.

Fidelis Partnership Taps Ascot’s Donovan as Head of U/W, Property Binders This edition of International People Moves details appointments at the broker Augment Risk and the managing general agent The Fidelis Partnership.

item.title: Markets/Coverages: Rokstone’s Athena Cyber Division Launches Supply Chain Extension
item.description: Rokstone, the London-based specialty re/insurance managing general agent (MGA), announced that its new Athena Cyber Division has launched a customer and supplier supply chain disruption extension. Unlike traditional contingency business interruption cover, Rokstone Athena’s cyber supply chain extension responds where a cyber-attack on a key supplier prevents an insured from operating, or where an incident affecting a major customer prevents them from purchasing an insured’s goods/services. “Our new extension recognizes that cyber events disrupt not only an organization’s own systems, but also the wider commercial relationships on which they depend,” commented Debbie Hobbs, president and head of Cyber at Rokstone Athena, in a statement.

item.title: Lincoln Financial CFO to depart
item.description: Lincoln Financial announced that CFO Chris Neczypor is leaving the company to pursue an opportunity outside the insurance industry. Neczypor, who has served as CFO for the past three years, will remain with Lincoln through the end of August to support the transition. Adam Cohen, Lincoln’s chief accounting officer and treasurer, has been named interim CFO, effective immediately.

item.title: Exzeo launches AI venture division
item.description: Exzeo has launched Exzeo Ventures, a new division focused on building AI-native products, services, and businesses, primarily around insurance. The division will primarily develop initiatives internally, drawing on Exzeo’s existing insurance and technology capabilities. Rather than using AI simply to automate existing workflows, Exzeo Ventures will look for opportunities and business models that the company believes weren’t economically or technologically feasible before AI.

item.title: El Niño May Cause Fewer Hurricanes in North America, Limiting Insurance Losses, Zurich CEO Says
item.description: The development of El Niño climate phenomenon might limit catastrophe claims in North America, the CEO of Zurich Insurance said last week after it reported second-quarter results. “What we hear is that this development of El Niño is actually moderating the risk of typhoons and hurricanes, especially on the American coasts. coastlines have increased the amount of property exposed to hurricanes, meaning that even a relatively quiet hurricane season can produce severe losses.

item.title: Alacrity Solutions Names Triola Chief Revenue Officer
item.description: Alacrity Solutions Group LLC named Tony Triola chief revenue officer. Triola will oversee Alacrity’s revenue strategy, including business development, sales and customer growth initiatives. Alacrity is a provider of insurance claims management services, delivering property, auto, and casualty claims adjustment, staffing support, temporary housing services, in addition to subrogation and recovery solutions.

item.title: Allstate Introduces Large Language Model, ALLIE
item.description: Allstate CEO Tom Wilson said the insurer has a “technology-drive strategy, not a strategy supported by technology.” And the next step in the strategy is the build of ALLIE – Allstate’s Large Language Intelligent Ecosystem. The coordination and configuration of the computer systems it has already built “is helping us accelerate the build and deployment of ALLIE.” Wilson told the analysts that the large language model is “just another step along the continuum that we’ve been on for a long time” when it comes to artificial intelligence. He said Allstate spends a “tremendous amount of time and effort on cybersecurity,” adding he is “concerned about the large language models that now break out on their own and tell other agents how to do it without getting caught.”

item.title: DAC Beachcroft expands Cyber team with three new partners
item.description: International law firm DAC Beachcroft has bolstered its Cyber and Data Risk practice with the appointment of three specialist cyber partners: Richard Breavington, Rachel Ford, and Daniel Guilfoyle. The trio joins from RPC where they were partners in its Cyber & Technology Insurance team, led by Breavington. item.title: REVO submits binding offer to acquire Eurocaution in planned Benelux expansion
item.description: REVO Insurance S.p.A., an Italian speciality non-life insurer, has announced the submission of a binding offer to acquire Luxembourg-based Eurocaution S.A. According to REVO Insurance, the acquisition would represent another step in its international expansion strategy following the launch of its Spanish operations in November 2024. The insurer stated that adding Eurocaution to the group would strengthen its presence in the European surety market, an area where REVO Insurance already holds a leading position in Italy.

item.description: The agreement establishes Hellenic Hull as Accredited’s first dedicated MGA partner for these classes and marks the insurer’s strategic expansion into specialist ocean marine underwriting. We look forward to working with Ilias and his team to develop a profitable and sustainable marine portfolio together.” Ilias Tsakiris, Chief Executive Officer of Hellenic Hull, said, “We are very pleased to welcome Accredited as a new partner and particularly proud that Hellenic Hull has been selected for its first dedicated ocean marine programme. Hellenic Hull’s depth of marine expertise, established distribution, integrated claims capabilities and disciplined underwriting approach made it the right partner for our first dedicated Hull & Machinery and Marine Cargo program.
